chunks: 4988 - Al-Qasim ibn Muhammad narrated from Abd al-Samad ibn Bashir from Sulayman ibn Hilal, who said:

One of our companions asked Abu Abdillah عليه السلام, saying: “May I be your ransom, a man sleeps with another man under one blanket.” He said: “Is he a mahram?” He said: “No.” He said: “Out of necessity?” He said: “No.” He said: “They are each to be lashed thirty lashes, thirty lashes.”

He said: “What if he did it?” He said: “If it was less than penetration, then the hadd applies; but if he penetrated, he is made to stand, then struck one blow with the sword, and the sword takes from him whatever it takes.” He said: So I said to him: “Then that is killing?” He said: “That is so.”

I said: “And a woman who slept with another woman under one blanket?” He said: “Is she a mahram?” I said: “No.” He said: “Out of necessity?” I said: “No.” He said: “They are each to be lashed thirty lashes, thirty lashes.”
I said: “What if she did it?” He said: That weighed heavily upon him, so he said: “Uff, uff, uff” three times, and said: “The hadd.”

key_terms.ذُو مَحْرَمٍ: a person within prohibited degrees of marriageable kinship
key_terms.مِنْ ضَرُورَةٍ: due to necessity or compelling need

ai.seo_question: What punishment does Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام mention for two men or two women sleeping together under one blanket or committing a prohibited sexual act?
ai.summary: This hadith presents a legal ruling from Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام concerning two men or two women lying together under one covering without kinship or necessity, and the punishments associated with that conduct. It distinguishes between mere proximity under one blanket and the commission of the prohibited act, stating fixed legal punishment in the latter case and indicating the gravity of such offenses in Islamic jurisprudence.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4988 - Al-Qasim ibn Muhammad narrated from Abd Al-Ṣamad ibn Bashir from Sulayman ibn Hilal who said:

One of our companions asked Abu Abdullah (as), saying: "May I be your ransom, what is the ruling on a man sleeping with another man under one blanket?"
Imam (as) asked: "Is he a close relative (mahram)?"
The man replied: "No."
Imam (as) asked: "Is it due to necessity?"
The man said: "No."
Imam (as) said: "They are each to be lashed thirty lashes."

The man asked: "What if the act was committed?"
Imam (as) replied: "If it was less than penetration, then the prescribed punishment (hadd) applies. But if penetration occurred, he is to be made to stand and struck with the sword, and the sword will take from him whatever it takes."
The man asked: "So, that is execution?"
Imam (as) replied: "That is correct."

The man then asked: "And what if a woman sleeps with another woman under one blanket?"
Imam (as) asked: "Is she a close relative (mahram)?"
The man replied: "No."
Imam (as) asked: "Is it due to necessity?"
The man replied: "No."
Imam (as) said: "They are each to be lashed thirty lashes."

The man further asked: "And if they committed the act?"
This greatly distressed Imam (as), and Imam (as) said: "Uff! Uff! Uff!" (three times), then said:
"The prescribed punishment (hadd) applies."
